description: A month grid for picking a single date, several dates or a date range.
overview:
`Calendar` renders one or more month grids with a caption, previous and next buttons, weekday headers and pressable day cells. Selection mode is set with `mode`: `single`, `multiple` or `range`. Ranges are drawn as a continuous shaded band with filled start and end days.

Three sizes are available: `sm`, `default` and `lg`. The caption can be a plain label or month and year dropdowns built on Select, which suits birth dates and other dates far from today.
usage:
Pass `mode`, `selected` and `onSelect` to control the selection; `selected` is a `Date`, a `Date[]` or a `{ from, to }` range depending on the mode. Use `month`, `defaultMonth` and `onMonthChange` to control the visible month, and `numberOfMonths` to show several months.

Use `disabled` with date matchers, such as `{ dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }`, to block days. Limit navigation with `startMonth` and `endMonth`; with a year dropdown they default to the last 100 years.

Set `locale` for month and weekday names, and `weekStartsOn` to change the first day of the week. `CalendarDayButton` is exported for custom day rendering.

examples.DropdownCaption: Month and year dropdowns in the caption.
examples.WeekNumbers: Week numbers in a leading column.
examples.OutsideDays: Days from adjacent months shown with `showOutsideDays`.
examples.ButtonVariants: Navigation buttons in the `ghost`, `secondary` and `tinted` variants.
examples.Locale: Turkish month and weekday names with `locale="tr-TR"`.

parts.Calendar: Month grids with caption and navigation.
parts.CalendarDayButton: Pressable day cell styled for each selection state.

Calendar.buttonVariant: Button variant for the navigation buttons. Defaults to `plain`.
Calendar.showOutsideDays: Shows days from the previous and next months.
Calendar.fixedWeeks: Always renders six weeks per month.
Calendar.onMonthChange: Called when the visible month changes.
Calendar.startMonth: Earliest month you can navigate to.
Calendar.endMonth: Latest month you can navigate to.
Calendar.disabled: Date matchers for days that cannot be selected.
Calendar.locale: Locale for month and weekday names.

accessibility:
- Each month is a `grid` labelled with its caption.
- Day cells have the `button` role, a full date label, and `selected` and `disabled` state.
- The previous and next buttons are labelled "Go to the Previous Month" and "Go to the Next Month".
- Caption dropdowns are labelled "Choose the Month" and "Choose the Year".
notes:
- Navigation arrows swap in right-to-left layouts.
- Uses `bg-accent`, `bg-accent-surface`, `bg-surface-secondary` and `text-link` tokens; light and dark follow the system appearance.
